---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement
title: "[enhancement] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## What do you want?

A clear, concise description of the feature or improvement.

## Why do you want it?

What problem does this solve? Who benefits? What's the use case?

## Alternatives you considered

What other approaches did you think about? Why is this one better?

## Rough implementation notes (optional)

If you have a sense of where in the codebase this would live (`layer/agents/`, `cli/`, `layer/workflows/`, etc.), describe it here. Not required.

## Would you be willing to submit a PR?

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to implement this myself.
- [ ] I can help review/test, but not implement.
- [ ] No, I'm just filing the idea.

## Additional context

Links, prior art, related issues, or anything else useful.
